# JANDÉ — Once Upon A Time

> Once Upon A Time is a free 8-bit side-scrolling browser game made for singer Jandé's song 'Once Upon A Time.' Help Jandé run, jump, slide and fight her way to the spotlight while The Groom Who Lied chases her through the enchanted halls. Nine stages with bosses and hidden caches; play on phone or desktop, no registration required.

- Genre: Platformer / runner / beat 'em up
- Platform: Web browser (mobile and desktop), installable PWA
- Made for: Jandé
- Developer: PRODBYKCTW LLC (Melvin D. Brown III, @prodbyKCTW) / RARƎ AGENCY
- Price: free
